## 主张 Claim

实践机器是一条部分律：它的轨迹恰是其完成的运行。门控改变之律的实例：只有修订改变记录的做法，只有组织采纳改变规则，所以每段不含它们的进程保持两者。一轮实践，对每个状态：审查者与工作者的一轮（尝试、回应、修订、经检验的重试）完成，恰当工作者在场、审查者是在场的在册者且不是工作者、审查者所记的做法应答当前处境；完成后记下审查、把处境的做法装入工作者、完成试验，别无改变。所以工作者此后已受训，受训的审查者无需再检，受训沿每段不含修订、回到原处境的进程保持。完整历史的三轮是实例；步定义是该机器自身的，其间的接纳与交接在该历史上检查。在明示二方法任务中，实际尝试与回应形成做法修订；成功重试产生既有程序所需审查关系，授权接纳后的参与者可回应下一次实践，并在最初回应者离开后继续形成新的参与关系。 / The practice machine is a partial law: its traces are exactly its completed runs. Instances of the gated-change law: only revision changes the recorded methods and only an organizational adoption changes the rule, so every course without them keeps both. A practice round, for every state: the round of attempt, response, revision and tested retry by a reviewer and a worker completes exactly when the worker is present and the reviewer is a present roster member other than the worker whose recorded method answers as the current context does; it then records the review, installs the context’s method in the worker, completes the trial and changes nothing else. So the worker is then trained, a trained reviewer needs no further check, and training is kept along every course without revision that returns to the context. The three rounds of the complete history are instances; the step definitions are the machine’s own, and the enrollments and handoff between the rounds are checked on that history. Within the declared two-method task, actual attempts and responses form a revised procedure. A successful retry produces the review relation consumed by the existing admission process; admitted participation enables later response and formation of further participation after the initial reviewer leaves.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 二方法任务、当前检验关系、推断操作、正确种子做法与一个资格给定。 / The two-method task, current test relation, inference operation, correct seed configuration and one mandate are supplied.
- 记录、通信、执行、可用参与者、具体次序、遵守程序及固定较高授权条件给定；交接不自动删除登记席位。 / Records, communication, execution, available participants, event order, compliance and fixed higher authorization are supplied; handoff does not automatically delete recorded offices.

同一状态历史中的尝试、回应、修订、检验及认可关系分化；配置是局部可执行做法，不能当成人类理解的完整模型。原始群体学习与换人研究仅为有限经验根据，并非该历史的实证复现。 修订同时读取先前实际结果和回应，核对后保留或改变做法；二方法内的等价性已查。 / Attempt, response, revision, testing and recognition differentiate within one state history. Configuration is a local executable procedure, not a full model of human understanding. Primary group-learning and turnover studies provide bounded empirical motivation, not reproduction of this exact history. Revision reads the earlier actual result together with the response, retaining or changing the procedure after comparison; equivalence within the two-method family is checked.

## 检验与边界 Validation and boundaries

22项新定理声明／51项新声明审计；81项继承审计独立分列，实际三模块闭包共132项。作者反审与原始摘要阅读另列，无独立agent验收。 / 22 new theorem declarations / 51 new declaration audits, separately from 81 inherited audits; 132 in the actual three-module closure. Author counterreview and primary-abstract readings are separate; no independent-agent acceptance.

仅闭合实际实践形成后续参与的一段连接；未推出人员到来、一般认知、任务及检验关系的形成、无限自维持或比较优越性。 / Closes one enacted-practice-to-further-participation connection, not arrival of people, general cognition, formation of tasks/test relations, indefinite self-maintenance or comparative superiority.

- 无回应、未修订、过早离开、处境改变和未检验便申请接纳均有失败；局部操作成功时，更高接纳条件仍可能失败。 / Missing response or revision, early departure, changed context and untested admission fail; local operation can succeed while higher admission conditions fail.
